$comment: Written by `agentic-factory init`. Every project-specific value lives here; the handbooks, templates and scripts read it. Never put secrets in this file.

rhythm.$modes: day-plan-night-build: the human plans, tests and decides by day, the Controller builds unattended at night, morning handover; continuous: the Controller builds whenever signed-off work exists and asks as questions arise; custom: quietHours define when the Controller may start new work

steering.$modes: github-issues: tickets are GitHub issues with labels; orca-tasks: tickets are docs/tasks/T<n>-*.md files

hosts.$comment: A remote server is an option, not a must. The controller runs on one host (the local machine or a remote one). Workers run on zero or more hosts; each has its own paths, Orca environment and capacity. With no remote hosts everything runs locally.

agents.$runners: orca: workers run in Orca worktrees and terminals; terminal: workers run as plain codex/claude/pi processes in git worktrees
agents.$calibration: The model names are examples of what the agent CLI offers; init asks for the available ones. auto: calibrate-models.mjs moves a role one tier down when its pass rate is high and rounds are low, one tier up when failures cluster; manual: it only recommends.

capacity.$comment: Defaults for every worker host; a host's own capacity block overrides single values.

calibration.$comment: The caps above are starting values. auto: start low (startSuite), raise by step while the host stays quiet for raiseAfterQuietMinutes at the cap, lower on pressure or load timeouts; the audit verifies. manual: use the configured caps as they are.
